def test_get_config_data_editorconfig():
    # Simulating an editorconfig file read
    config_data = _get_config_data('sample_config.editorconfig', ('[*]', 'indent_style'))
    assert config_data['source'] == 'sample_config.editorconfig'  # Validate source path
    assert config_data['indent'] == '    '  # Check if indent is set with spaces


def test_get_config_data_empty_file():
    # Testing with an empty file
    config_data = _get_config_data('empty_config.toml', ('section1',))
    assert config_data == {}  # Expect an empty dictionary


def test_get_config_data_invalid_file_type():
